comments.author: a-barboza
comments.body:
@liushilongbuaa @renukamanavalan 

I think the windows filesystem cannot handle the ":" in the filename. Can you confirm? If so, I can put in a PR to take out the ":" from the Unit Tests.

`C:\>type 10.10.10.1:1645.conf
The filename, directory name, or volume label syntax is incorrect.

C:\>type 10.10.10.1.conf
The system cannot find the file specified.

C:\>`

comments.author: liushilongbuaa
comments.body: A file name can't contain any of the following characters:  \ / : * ? " < > |
